items.title: The Next $100 Billion of Netflix’s Value Could Come From Here, 98% Upside Ahead
items.summary: Netflix shares have shed more than a third of their value over the past year, yet the company's ad business is exploding and buybacks are hitting record pace. items.title: Should You Buy Netflix Stock Because Its Earnings Outrun Its Sales?
items.summary: Netflix (NFLX) has fallen about 35% over the past year, while the S&P 500 returned about 17%. The complaint is simple. Sales growth is slowing, and management will not show the quality metrics it leans on. That case misses the engine under per-share earnings, a wider margin, and a shrinking share count.
